b.x: Whoever is not yet diabetic does not earn the disease in one sweet. They earn it on the everyday plate: a sweet drink, juice in a tall glass, a biscuit in the place of food, white bread as the meal, and a body that does not move. Type 1 is not born from the plate. Type 2, in most houses, arrives with the weight, the bad sleep, and this table. The page does not cure whoever already has it. Whoever already has it follows the doctor and the meter. Whoever does not have it yet can choose not to invite it.

Brazil, without theater. The Ministry of Health, in April 2025, spoke of about 20 million people with diabetes, near 10 percent of the population. In the public system, in 2023, there were 11,326 leg or foot amputation procedures linked to diabetes. In the first half of 2024, 5,710 more. A procedure is not a person: the same person can enter more than once, and the number is the public network. The press, citing the International Diabetes Federation, spoke of 111 thousand deaths related to diabetes in Brazil in 2024. A study with DATASUS counted 140,792 deaths in 2023 and 2024 together. The two counts do not measure the same thing. The house does not pick the larger one to frighten. Both are already enough to take the plate seriously.

The plate the house already knows. Half the plate is leaves, tomato, cucumber, zucchini, okra, cabbage, kale. A fist of beans, lentils, or grain, not a mountain of white rice. A palm of egg, sardine, chicken, or meat, without frying as the rule. Real oats, not the sweet packet. Yogurt without sugar, if the body accepts it. Whole fruit, with the fiber: apple, pear, orange. Banana in a piece, not three. Nuts, a fist, not the bag. The drink is water. Juice is not fruit. A biscuit is not the snack of someone who wants to stay far from the meter.

Food alone does not hold. Walk after the plate, sleep, and do not turn the fear of the number into one more night of news. Whoever already measures writes the number in the Vigil and does not change the medicine because of this page.
